_meta.description: Candidate axis tick-mark pixel-position ground truth for verified_pairs, generated by two independent vision-LLM judges. NOT human-verified. See docs/design/benchmark-architecture.md and https://github.com/t29mato/real-chart-bench/issues/5 for context and known caveats (multi-panel/inset ambiguity across several verified_pairs images). Originally 42 entries (PR #6, models: claude-opus-5 vs claude-fable-5); extended to all 111 verified_pairs entries on 2026-08-30 (69 new entries, same claude-opus-5 vs claude-fable-5 cross-check methodology, adjudicated by a Claude session reviewing both passes directly against the source images for every disagreement -- see design 7.44).
_meta.method: Each of 42 verified_pairs images was shown independently to claude-opus-5 and claude-fable-5, asked to read the smallest/largest tick label on each axis and the pixel coordinate of that tick, then cross-checked its own answer via pixel-level dark-line/tick profiling (not just a single vision read). Agreement across the two independent models: 42/42 identical tick label values; pixel-position disagreement averaged 0.030% and maxed 0.22% of the relevant image dimension (~1-3px). This is a strong *consistency* signal, not proof of correctness -- a 10-image subset was also spot-checked visually by overlaying both models' picks on the source image.

status_values.llm_candidate: Both models agree on tick labels; pixel positions are the mean of the two models' estimates. Not yet human-verified.
status_values.owner_reviewed: The repo owner visually spot-checked this entry's overlay (both models' picks rendered on the source image) and confirmed it looks correct. Still LLM-generated, not independently re-measured by a human.
